title: Understanding the Model
text: The model is predicting $$self_{rating}$$ using a linear combination of $$critic_1$$ and its square. This is a polynomial regression model.

title: Role of L1 Regularization
text: L1 regularization, also known as Lasso, adds a penalty equal to the absolute value of the magnitude of coefficients. It can lead to sparse solutions where some coefficients are exactly zero.

title: Effect of L1 Regularization on Coefficients
text: Consider how L1 regularization might affect the coefficients $$\theta_1$$ and $$\theta_2$$. It tends to shrink some coefficients to zero, effectively selecting a simpler model.
